description: This file declares the DownloadManagerHttpClient class responsible for managing HTTP downloads, including methods for starting downloads, pausing, resuming, cancelling, setting rate limits, and retrieving progress and status codes. It also defines internal callback functions and private member variables for thread safety and cURL handle management.

classes.name: DownloadManagerHttpClient
classes.description: A class encapsulating HTTP download operations using libcurl, providing control over download flow and configuration.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Initiates a file download from a given URL to a specified file name with an optional rate limit.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses the ongoing download by invoking libcurl's pause function with the pause flags.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes a paused download using libcurl's pause feature.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing download by setting an internal cancellation flag.

methods.name: setRateLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum receive speed for the download.

methods.name: getProgress
methods.description: Returns the current progress status of the download.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Placeholder method for setting an authentication token.

methods.name: setCert
methods.description: Placeholder method for setting SSL certificate.

methods.name: setCertPath
methods.description: Placeholder method for setting SSL certificate path.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the last download operation.
